timingMethod: Actual automated browser operations at the public addresses. Captions use observed wall-clock event times aligned to recorded clip durations. Separate owner and recipient browser clips are joined in operation order; no UI is simulated.

chapters.en: Open the public Moon explorer in a fresh browser.
chapters.zh: 在全新浏览器中打开公开月球探索页面。

chapters.en: Drag the real 3D Moon, then locate its south pole.
chapters.zh: 拖动真实三维月球，再定位南极。

chapters.en: Select supported ROI 6 and enter the workspace with a real horizontal transition.
chapters.zh: 选择有数据的连接脊6，以横向转场进入工作台。

chapters.en: Calculate and record the 24-hour darkness-limit baseline on the real cloud service.
chapters.zh: 在真实云服务计算并记录24小时断光门槛的基线。

chapters.en: Tighten the darkness limit to 8 hours and compute the changed decision.
chapters.zh: 把断光门槛调为8小时，重新计算条件变化后的判断。

chapters.en: Open the metric explanation and locate its actual continuous dark interval.
chapters.zh: 打开指标解释，定位实际的连续断光区间。

chapters.en: Compare two preserved scenarios; different thresholds have no universal ranking.
chapters.zh: 并排比较保留的两个方案，明确不同门槛不统一排名。

chapters.en: Save the complete cloud record as a named mission.
chapters.zh: 为完整云端记录命名并保存任务。

chapters.en: Refresh the page and reopen the saved original from My missions; no server restart is claimed.
chapters.zh: 刷新页面，从我的任务重新打开原始记录；本步骤不声称重启托管服务器。

chapters.en: Create a read-only share for a separate anonymous visitor.
chapters.zh: 创建只读分享，供另一匿名访客查看。

chapters.en: A separate browser context opens the read-only original record.
chapters.zh: 独立浏览器身份打开只读原始记录。

chapters.en: Export complete JSON and a readable report from the same saved evidence.
chapters.zh: 从同一份原始证据导出完整JSON与可阅读报告。
